name: How can I tell if I have a gas leak that requires isolation?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if I have a gas leak that requires isolation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a gas leak include the distinct smell of sulfur or rotten eggs, a hissing sound near gas lines or appliances, and a visible cloud or mist near a gas line. You might also notice dying vegetation in an area where a gas line runs underground. If you suspect a gas leak, do not operate electrical switches, light matches, or use your phone. Evacuate your property immediately, then call your gas provider and Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC from a safe location.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a gas leak include a sulfur smell, hissing sound, or dying plants near a gas line. Evacuate and call professionals.
